Select canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units for activity rows in assay CHEMBL1054500. Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, join compound_structures on molregno as an inner join, and join assays on assay_id. Filter by assays.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1054500', activities.standard_value IS NOT NULL, and activities.standard_relation = '='. Keep all qualifying activity rows without deduplication. Sort by canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units.
